recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If the work group wants a future explicit concept "=" filter distinct from existing equality/filter mechanisms, handle it as a new terminology decision rather than as a FHIR-36644 reconciliation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-36644 was a Published vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking CodeSystem.html#filters to define common "concept" filters for code systems that support is-a relationships. The approved resolution kept the hierarchy-filter text, required ballot-feedback commentary, and explicitly left evaluation of the proposed concept "=" row because equality was already covered by the existing filter section.
initial_application: Commit 5108b8c15893ab00de9661bf0702c73839073143 applied FHIR-36644 by adding the hierarchy-specific concept filter table to source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml with is-a, descendent-of, is-not-a, generalizes, child-of, and descendent-leaf rows plus an R5 ballot-feedback note. Later editorial and ballot-cleanup commits removed the temporary note while preserving the table.
additional_context: CodeSystem is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml is in current build scope. The current source still defines the common concept hierarchy filters, and later FHIR-48716 maintenance added concept in | not-in to the same table after evaluating related ValueSet filter-value semantics. The absence of a separate concept "=" row is consistent with the FHIR-36644 resolution rather than an omitted application.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding a redundant concept "=" row now would go beyond the published resolution and later applied maintenance, while the current source already gives implementers the common concept filters requested for hierarchical code systems.
